pico-cli

Usage:
  pico-cli [command] [options]

Options:
  -h, --help     Show this message and exit.
  -v, --version  Print version information and exit.

Commands:
  setup     Initialize local AI tool integrations and skills
  project   Create and bootstrap Spatial projects
  emulator  Emulator lifecycle, setup, and diagnostics
  device    Device connectivity and inspection commands
  app       Install, launch, and inspect apps
  files     Push, pull, and manage device files
  capture   Capture screenshots and recordings
  log       Read logcat output from the current target
  shell     Run a one-off shell command on the current target
  plugin    Update installed tool integrations
  doctor    Top-level environment diagnostics and module doctor routing
  update    Check for and install pico-cli updates
  editor    Spatial Editor lifecycle commands
  mcp       MCP and dev knowledge utilities
  perf      Spatial app performance utilities
  web       WebApp service setup and launch utilities
